text:
Amanda K: Morning team — consolidating customer asks and launch gates for the field launch of the Private Deployment VPC/on-prem package. Want to lock down minimal SLA, upgrade path guarantees, and what customers can self-manage vs require Redwood networking. I'll paste a draft checklist.

Jon S: Quick Q: are we including rolling upgrade support day one? Some customers asked for 0-downtime.

Priya R: For MVP we committed to in-place upgrades (short restart window) not full rolling. We should scope rolling upgrades to post-launch phase 1.

Luis M: Ops concern: if customers manage their own NAT + IPAM we still need health endpoints + handshakes. Need a clear L7 probe and out-of-band agent heartbeat.

Amanda K: Agreed. Draft checklist:
```
- must-have: VPC peering + IP allowlist docs
- must-have: agent heartbeat + version pin
- launch-if: in-place upgrade <= 2 min restart
- post-launch: rolling upgrade support
- security: KMS integration + audit logs
```

Emily Z: We should add acceptance criteria for network flakiness: e.g., system should tolerate 30s intermittent connectivity and auto-retry handshakes.

Jon S: Customer asks: they want ability to rotate TLS certs manually. Is that in scope?

Priya R: yes. Manual TLS rotation + documented steps. Automate as future work.

Luis M: Also add fallback routing policy when endpoint unreachable: route to hosted fallback model with configurable throttling. That touches pricing/legal.

Amanda K: Ok noted. Need owners for each item for sprint 0: assign me for product docs, Jon infra for upgrade patterns, Priya for security/KMS, Luis for runtime/heartbeat, Emily for telemetry + acceptance tests. Agree?

Jon S: Agree. I'll start a tech spec PR w/ perf targets.

deploy-bot: deploy:infra: staging deployment scheduled at 2289456200 — infra-test-01.

Amanda K: Quick ask — any customer blockers that must bump scope? @Luis M mentioned fallback routing might require legal signoff for cross-region failover. Can you confirm?

Luis M: Confirmed. For some EU customers we can't route to US-hosted fallback. Need per-customer region policy. That adds a gating item.

Emily Z: Proposed metric: E2E request success >= 99.5 during 24h soak on staging before rollout.

Amanda K: I'll update the checklist and will run a customer-facing survey to validate the wishlist. Optional: can someone mock up the upgrade sequence diagram? 2–3 steps.

Priya R: I'll sketch it today.

Jon S: Thanks — ping me when the tech spec PR is up. :thumbsup:
